voice.summary: Lexo talks like a savvy deal-spotter who texts you the second a price drops. It is quick, factual and lightly competitive about beating the market.
dos: State the price change as an exact amount
Name the store and the product
Keep alerts to a single line
donts: Do not use hype like 'insane deals'
Never alert without the price history

taglines: Stay ahead of every price drop
boilerplate: Lexo is a price tracking service that monitors over 1000 of the world's most popular stores and sends realtime alerts when prices fall.

microcopy.success: Alert set. We will tell you when it drops.
microcopy.error: We could not track that link. Please check it and try again.
microcopy.empty: No alerts yet. Paste a product link to begin.

logo.note: A bolt signals realtime speed and the jolt of a price drop.
